defects.what: The frame is two stacked images (a sparking ship scene on top, a near-duplicate with a boy on a deck below) split by a hard horizontal seam at mid-height.
The frame is three stacked horizontal panels (galleons, then a black yacht, then the yacht again) with visible seams, a collage instead of one shot.
Thick black letterbox bars fill the top and bottom fifth of the frame, leaving the feather picture as a frame inside the frame.
Large glowing pseudo-Latin letters (X, N, K, Z shapes) fill the open document in the lower left foreground.
The growling dog in the bottom right is a brown long-haired dog with no red kerchief or white chest patch, not Usman.
The Laguna Copperplate is drawn as a round tray covered in dense rows of CJK-like pseudo-glyphs instead of a rectangular plate with Kawi script.
A thin black border runs around all four edges of the picture.
Hanging signboards in the upper right background carry Chinese-style characters.
A vertical banner in the upper right corner carries a column of CJK-like glyphs.
The glowing tablet in the keel at the top centre is covered in rows of pseudo-glyphs.
Both pages of the open book are filled with lines of pseudo-text.
The contract papers held at centre show scribbled pseudo-text lines and letter-like marks.
Besides the glowing signatures, the scattered contracts carry rows of pseudo-text and form-like headings.
The papers under the hand at the bottom carry small lines of pseudo-text.
